planets.name: Kepler-1650 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1650 with a 1.54-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: Kepler-1650 b was found in 2017 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-1650. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
